name: FloraSelector
author: ollicom

sections.description:
FloraSelector helps visitors find plants that match their garden, balcony or planter.

The Free edition includes:

  • Climate-based plant recommendations
  • Postal-code climate support for Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and France
  • Standard FloraSelector plant database
  • Standard FloraSelector image repository
  • Plant safety information
  • Automatic and manual plant combinations
  • Plant quantity calculations
  • Unlimited custom plants
  • Unlimited custom images
  • FloraSelector interface in Dutch, English, German and French
  • Regional add-on support

FloraSelector is a complete standalone plugin and does not require a license.

FloraSelector Affiliate and FloraSelector Pro are separate commercial editions distributed outside WordPress.org. Premium code and the commercial licensing system are not included in this plugin.

External service

FloraSelector can download its standard Core plant images from:

https://assets.floraselector.com/core/images/

This external asset service is used only when a WordPress administrator explicitly loads the Core image catalogue, verifies image links, or imports standard FloraSelector images from the plugin’s Repository screen.

The plugin requests only the public image files needed for the standard 73-plant Core catalogue. It does not send visitor profiles, plant-advisor answers, frontend postal codes, analytics data or commercial license information.

The images are copied into the site’s WordPress Media Library under wp-content/uploads/floraselector/core/.

Storage/CDN provider: Cloudflare R2. Service owner: Ollicom Belgium / FloraSelector.com.

FloraSelector privacy policy: https://floraselector.com/privacy-policy/

FloraSelector Terms of Service: https://floraselector.com/floraselector-terms-of-service/

Cloudflare privacy policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

Cloudflare website terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/

Privacy

FloraSelector does not include analytics or user tracking.

Frontend plant-advisor input is processed by the plugin for the recommendation and is not sent to the FloraSelector Image Repository.

The only built-in external network functionality is the administrator-initiated standard image download and link check described above.

Commercial editions

An informational page in the FloraSelector administration menu explains the separately distributed Affiliate and Pro editions and links to FloraSelector.com. This information is shown only in the plugin administration area and does not add promotional links to the public website.

Source code

The JavaScript and CSS shipped in this plugin are the human-readable source files used directly by WordPress. They are not generated by npm, webpack, a minifier, or another build tool, and no build step is required. In particular, assets/app.js is the maintained source file itself.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate FloraSelector Free.
  2. Go to FloraSelector > 1. Import images.
  3. Load the Core image catalogue and import the missing standard images.
  4. On activation, FloraSelector automatically creates the public FloraSelector page.
  5. Go to FloraSelector > 2. Create pages to verify or manage that page.
  6. Open the page and test the plant advisor.

The standard plant database, postal code data and plant climate data are already included in the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does FloraSelector require a license?

No. FloraSelector Free works without a license.

Does the plugin send visitor data to FloraSelector.com?

No. The built-in external asset connection is used only when an administrator explicitly loads, verifies or imports standard images. Frontend plant-advisor answers are not sent to the asset service.

Are Affiliate and Pro features locked inside this plugin?

No. The commercial editions are distributed separately and their premium implementation is not included in FloraSelector Free.

How many custom plants and images can I add?

FloraSelector Free supports Unlimited custom plants and custom images.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Added plant image thumbnails to the Top 20 recommendations.
  • Improved the Top 20 plant recommendation and selection interface.
  • Improved manual and automatic planting combinations.
  • Added clearer plant quantities and placement information for planting combinations.
  • Improved multilingual texts and frontend styling.

1.0.3

  • Added complete FloraSelector language handling for Dutch, English, German and French, matching the commercial edition structure.
  • Added separate visitor and administration language settings plus a frontend language selector.
  • Added translated plant names/content from the maintained FloraSelector translation dataset.
  • Updated the Free / Affiliate / Pro information page to the current feature matrix and removed outdated yearly-price text.
  • Corrected the image-import status label and clarified that customer accounts and saved projects are available only in Pro.
  • The automatically created selector page now uses the floraselector slug (with floraselector-planten as conflict fallback).
  • Moved standard Core image delivery to Cloudflare R2 at assets.floraselector.com.
  • Removed the runtime Piwigo catalogue scan from the Free image workflow.
  • Standard Core images are now stored locally under uploads/floraselector/core/.
  • Existing image filenames and stable plant IDs are preserved.

1.0.2

  • Hardened backup restore: uploaded backup values are never PHP-deserialized.
  • New backups store JSON-native option values (backup format 3).
  • Legacy backups containing serialized option values are rejected safely.

1.0.1

  • WordPress.org review compliance update: enqueued admin assets, hardened backup restore, corrected writable storage, source documentation and external-service disclosure.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release of FloraSelector Free.
  • Standalone Free edition without commercial licensing code.
  • Includes the core plant advisor, climate data, standard plants and repository integration.
